Prototype dataset for an AI-assisted career recommendation platform focused initially on engineering college students.
Engineering students across Computer, IT, ECE, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil and Chemical branches.
All profiles are generated examples, not real student data. Use for UI demos, recommendation logic testing and prototype development.
Use Student_Profile_Dataset to test profile intake and recommendation cards. Use Career_Domain_Catalog to populate domain details and roadmap content.
This dataset is not validated career guidance and should not be presented as ground-truth labels. Recommendations should be explainable and editable by students.

Score domain fit using skills, interests, preferred work style and aspiration. Return top 3 domains with match reasons, skill gaps, a stepwise roadmap and role categories. Allow users to revise inputs.
Collect only necessary data, ask consent, avoid storing sensitive personal information, and let students delete/export their profiles.
